title: SARS-CoV-2 Real-Time RT-PCR Protocol
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgtnjwme
materials: SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit

steps.title: Prepare synthetic controls
steps.instruction: Produce synthetic controls using the binary synthetic template oligonucleotide positive control for in-house diagnostic real-time RT-PCR method using the following sequences:

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mixture using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088) for use on a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex (100-place rotor discs) or an ABI 7500 Fast real-time machine.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total volume based on 20µL per reaction, including a 'dead volume' of usually 2 extra reactions (adjust if using a robotic dispenser).

steps.title: Dispense reagents and template
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction wells with the master mix and template.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 15µl of the reaction mixture into each reaction well.
Add 5µl of template, extracted RNA, controls, or NTC (nuclease-free water) to reach a total reaction volume of 20µl.

steps.title: Analyze results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following satisfactory positive criteria:

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, upward curve, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Confirm a suitable level of fluorescence intensity compared to a positive control (y-axis).
Identify a defined threshold cycle (CT) value that exceeds the threshold early in the log-linear phase.
Confirm that NTCs do not produce a curve.
Classify results as negative if the CT value is 40 cycles.
